open_issues.text: F1 not fixed in documents: retention (PurgeTrashCommand::runMaintenance, its own transaction around PurgeNodeAction) and the drive purge step (PurgeDriveStepAction → PurgeNodeAction's own transaction) bypass OperationRunner, so no documents-side hook can drain before their transaction. While a marker is set, both refuse with document_state_pending (rolled back, nothing removed) and never call the drainer. They converge once the marker is cleared: the next retention run or drive-purge step succeeds (pinned by two PendingStateGuardTest cases). A real drain-or-409 there needs a drive-owned pre-transaction purge hook, a new drive SPI and slot (D8, needs a D#), or running those purges through OperationRunner as 'drive.trash.purge'. That is outside the documents write set and changes drive's architecture.

open_issues.text: rejected major finding packages/drive/src/Console/PurgeTrashCommand.php:70: A document carries pending marker (generation 0, through seq 3) and an active PendingStateDrainer whose drain() would publish a covering checkpoint. vaulter:trash:purge opens a transaction at PurgeTrashCommand.php:70 and calls PurgeNodeAction inside it. PendingPurgeDrain.php:34 runs only for a root drive.trash.purge operation, so drainTrashed() is never called. DocumentContentLifecycle::purge() then assertSettled() under that transaction and throws document_state_pending. The command catches it, leaves the row and the marker in place, and exits 1. The same document on a drive in status Deleting is removed by PurgeDriveStepAction.php:73 with bypassTrashRequirement and no prior drain, so the step throws DocumentStatePendingException and the drive stays Deleting. PendingStateGuardTest.php lines 272–299 lock this in: guardDrainer(publish: true) and FakePendingStateDrainer::$calls stays empty. C9 requires drain outside the transaction, then a fresh lock, and 409 only when the marker is still set. Triage reason: Reproduces as described, but the defect lives in packages/drive (PurgeTrashCommand.php:70 and PurgeDriveStepAction.php:73), which runs PurgeNodeAction in its own transaction without calling documents' PendingPurgeDrain first. That is outside this item's write set. The behaviour inside the documents contract is fail-closed: DocumentContentLifecycle::purge refuses with 409 document_state_pending, no row is deleted, and the purge converges once the marker clears. No silent loss occurs. The documents test pins this on purpose and names drive as the owner of the boundary. Owner: the drive module, in a later drive/P5 item. The fix there is to drain pending documents (PendingPurgeDrain::drainTrashed) outside the transaction before opening it in the retention command and the drive purge step. Recorded as a rejected Major plan note.

summary: Correction round 3 of the P5.3 review fixes. F2 fixed: PendingStateGuard::drainTrashed() no longer drains a fixed batch (orderBy id, limit 100). It reads every marked trashed document of the drive in keyset pages of 100 (id > last) and drains each one once per call, so documents whose drain never settles cannot starve the purge target; the constant is renamed PURGE_DRAIN_PAGE. F1 (retention purge and drive purge step) cannot be fixed inside documents and is reported as a deviation owned by drive. PurgeTrashCommand::runMaintenance and PurgeDriveStepAction call PurgeNodeAction in transactions of their own, outside OperationRunner, so the OperationMiddleware seam (PendingPurgeDrain) never runs. A drain before those transactions needs a drive-side pre-transaction purge hook, i.e. a new or changed drive SPI and slot, an architecture change that needs a D#. PendingStateGuardTest: the test helper guardSettle() now publishes a covering checkpoint (the fake drainer reuses it). New cases: (1) F2 regression: 101 stuck marked trashed documents with lower ids plus a publishing drainer for the target; the purge drains all 102 once each and removes the target. (2) Retention purge (artisan vaulter:trash:purge --days=0) of a pending trashed document exits 1, keeps the document and never calls the drainer; after guardSettle() the next run exits 0 and removes it. (3) Drive purge step (PurgeDriveStepAction, drive status Deleting) throws DocumentStatePendingException, keeps the document and never calls the drainer; after guardSettle() it returns true and the document is gone. Runs, all exit 0 on sqlite: scripts/t sqlite -p documents tests/State/PendingStateGuardTest.php; scripts/t sqlite -p documents tests/State tests/Arch (35 State tests); scripts/t baseline --write -p documents then --compare -p documents (current 718, added 57).
